description: Convert images between WebP, JPEG, PNG and AVIF, including iPhone HEIC photos (on a Mac). Choose the quality, optionally shrink big images, and keep or strip metadata. Saved next to the originals with the new extension (never over them). For PDF pages to images use pdf_toolkit with action "to_images".

background.description: JPEG only: the colour for transparent areas, hex.

files.description: Image files or folders (a folder means the images in it). ~ is your home folder.

format.description: Convert to. WebP is usually 25–35% smaller than JPEG at the same quality; PNG is lossless (best for graphics and screenshots); AVIF is smaller still but slower to make.

max_edge.description: Shrink big images so their longer side is at most this many pixels (e.g. 2560, 1920, 1280). Smaller images are left their size.

metadata.description: "strip" removes EXIF, GPS and camera details (the site’s behaviour); "keep" carries them over.

output_dir.description: Folder to save results in. Default: next to each original. Originals are never overwritten.

name: convert_images
title: Convert images
